content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm very new to PLCs and [product_name], so I appreciate your patience. I'm planning to buy a [product_name] starter kit, and currently the best choice seems to be the [article_no] version [version_no]. If I buy this starter kit, will I be able to use the newer [product_name] software version [version_no] with it, since the [version_no] starter kit isn't available yet? Are there significant functional changes between the [product_name] controllers of version [version_no] and [version_no]? Additionally, many sample projects, like the traffic light example, are in German. Is there an English version, or can they be translated? Any guidance would be much appreciated.
Yes, you can use [product_name] version [version_no], since it's backward compatible. To clarify, there are no differences in core functionality. The main addition is the email feature.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking clarity about compatibility between different versions of [product_name] software and hardware, and have concerns about accessing documentation in English. Backward compatibility is confirmed, and the primary new feature noted is email capability. The desire for English-language sample projects highlights the need for better documentation for non-German speakers.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect new software releases to work with older hardware versions, to have access to instructions and sample projects in English, and hope that there are no critical differences between hardware releases.
